workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots when they are both free for the partner meeting next week:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30
Could you please check which of these times work for Elena and David? Thanks.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. Unfortunately, none of the times you suggested work for them. Here is a list of 30-minute slots when they are both free. Could you please check which of these work for Priya and Marcus?
Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Wed: 13:00, 13:30
Thu: 09:30, 15:00
Fri: 14:30, 15:00, 15:30
Thanks, Brad.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad. Thanks for the list of times. I've checked them against Priya's and Marcus's calendars and found a time that works for everyone: Thursday at 15:00. I've gone ahead and booked it. Can you please send the confirmation email to the partners? Thanks!

emails.body:
Dear Partners,

This email confirms the booking of the partners' meeting for next week.

The meeting is scheduled for Thursday, November 19, at 15:00 Eastern time for 30 minutes.

The attendees are Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor.

Best regards,
Brad
